changes.removed: RGB888 packing/unpacking, colour-mode commands and menu row, format switching/reset/CDC, high-colour cache restrictions, A legacy RGB888 framebuffer reader and read mux.
changes.memory: B horizontal scaler line buffers store exact RGB565 words at 16 bits; expand after synchronous RAM before vertical interpolation. The existing 8192-frame hybrid PCM FIFO is unchanged from 5.1.
changes.preserved: A HDMI/touch wiring, B preprocessing and AV2 envelope offload, 11 transitions, sparse dwell ripples, trophy spotlights and light tail, BMP24 decoding, audio and thumbnail preview.
changes.protocol: Existing 19-bit settings field retains bit 18 reserved zero; unsupported format requests are rejected. Native frames and extended RGB565 auxiliary/award payload lengths are preserved.
changes.fifo: A retains the 1024-word display FIFO because the water reader emits an atomic 640-word row and reserves 32 words; reducing to 512 would violate its admission contract.
